style_prompt.value: masterpiece, best quality, anime, clean bold outlines

card.architecture: SD1.5 lineart ControlNet (control_v11p_sd15_lineart) over the Counterfeit-V3 anime checkpoint, driven by a lineart preprocessor (coarse=bolder) — img2img re-render
card.summary: Re-renders the source as img2img at partial denoise with a lineart ControlNet enforcing the (coarse, bolder) outlines, so the character is preserved while the lines are redrawn clean and thick.
use_cases: redraw bold clean outlines while keeping the character
thicken outlines where a diffusion redraw beats a pixel op
card.pick_when: You want the outlines genuinely redrawn (not just dilated) and a diffusion pass is acceptable.
